subject: Need to build a User Interface for already existing R code (Interactive Code)

messages.author: 992bb1420d5c3b76
messages.subject: Need to build a User Interface for already existing R code (Interactive Code)
parts:
I have an R code, which basically asks the user to enter a few parameters and based on those parameters various plots will be plotted and saved inside a PDF file.

Now instead of command line interactive session, I want to build a GUI for the user to select the parameters from the list and then based on user selection again, does the plotting and save the result into PDF.

I have gone through the tutorial lessons on shiny.rstudio and I find building UI is not that much tough but invoking the user entered variables into the main server.r script is.

Does shiny support this? And does any basic example of reading user input into ui.R and passing it on to server.R exists somewhere?

Please help me on this. Meanwhile I am going through shiny in more details.

Thanks in advance.
